prompt: We run a private cloud on OpenStack with Kubernetes workloads for a healthcare SaaS product. We need to expose our patient portal and REST API to the internet while keeping our backend services and PostgreSQL databases completely internal. We're HIPAA compliant and use Cisco ACI for networking. The ops team wants to use FLOSS wherever possible. We've been hit by DDoS attacks before and had an SQL injection incident last year. How do we design the secure ingress architecture? Include DMZ design, WAF, API gateway, network segmentation, monitoring, and incident response.

assertions.name: dmz_zone_design
assertions.description: Designs a dedicated DMZ zone physically or logically separated from internal networks

assertions.name: waf_recommendation
assertions.description: Recommends specific WAF solution(s) with OWASP Top 10 coverage (ModSecurity, Coraza, or commercial)

assertions.name: api_gateway
assertions.description: Recommends API gateway for REST API protection (rate limiting, auth, validation)

assertions.name: tls_architecture
assertions.description: Addresses TLS termination and re-encryption between zones (not just 'use TLS')

assertions.name: ddos_mitigation
assertions.description: Addresses DDoS mitigation specifically (given their history)

assertions.name: network_segmentation_depth
assertions.description: Designs multi-layer segmentation (perimeter → DMZ → app → data) with specific firewall rules or ACI contracts

assertions.name: kubernetes_ingress
assertions.description: Covers Kubernetes-specific ingress (ingress controller, network policies, service mesh)

assertions.name: ids_ips
assertions.description: Recommends IDS/IPS at the perimeter (Suricata, Snort, or commercial)

assertions.name: siem_integration
assertions.description: Integrates all ingress logs into SIEM for correlation and alerting

assertions.name: sql_injection_prevention
assertions.description: Specifically addresses SQL injection prevention (given their history) beyond just WAF

assertions.name: hipaa_ingress_controls
assertions.description: Addresses HIPAA-specific controls for the internet-facing boundary (encryption, audit, access logging)

assertions.name: floss_choices
assertions.description: Recommends FLOSS solutions where possible (as requested) with specific product names
